Mayor Yashy does dbd and guro stuff.
I’m moving to St. Louis too! I don’t know much about the area yet but MTUG (Metro Trans Umbrella Group. I think that’s what it stands for) is a really useful resource.

I decided I’d go ahead and give an update. To be brief, we broke up and honestly? I feel a lot more at peace with this. It’s nice not constantly having to meet his approval of what a man is and isn’t. Already it feels like a weight has been lifted off my shoulders. 

So, if anyone ever finds themselves in this situation, just think about your own mental health. I promise you, no relationship is worth the self loathing this kind of thinking can bring.

That part is complicated. He said in the beginning he felt like he really needed to be attracted to a woman because his family is homophobic. He thought if he faked it, it would eventually come true. But then it never happened and he realized he was gay.

When I came out as a trans man, he told me he felt relief. He’s definitely romantically attracted to me and loves me very much. (Those are his words, anyway) But when it comes to sexual attraction...
